observations: Near-miss in lib/components/fabro-workflow/src/handler/llm/api.rs: the old else-branch registered the FULL fabro tool set on any node without a fabro_tools attribute whenever services existed, so a server-side-only fix would have silently granted all run tools to every develop stage (implementer, tester, reviewer) once the planner's opt-in provisioned services — the run_wide provenance field plus register_stage_fabro_run_tools gating is what keeps the approval's per-stage least privilege; reviewers should check the attribute-less-node case specifically.
